users.title: Users
users.lead: Access to the company. New users get an invitation by email that is valid for 7 days. Accounts can be disabled, not deleted.
users.inviteHint: The person sets their password and second factor through the link in the invitation.
users.name: Name
users.employeeHint: Links the account to a person so they can clock in
users.resetMfaText: The person has to set up a second factor again at the next sign-in and gets an email about it.
users.disableText: The person can no longer sign in. Time entries and the audit log are kept.

tenant.title: Company
tenant.lead: Settings for the whole company. The system always checks the statutory limits, this page only holds company rules.
tenant.name: Company name
tenant.optionalHolidaysHint: Only apply in parts of a state and are therefore switched on separately.

optionalWhere.corpus_christi: in parts of Saxony and Thuringia

tenant.halfDays: 24 and 31 December as half working days
tenant.capHint: Works agreement or contract, not law. A contract can have its own limits.

capModes.forfeit_at_close: excess is forfeited at month-end close

tenant.carryoverHint: Cut-off day in the following year as DD.MM., remaining leave can be taken until then
tenant.sandbox: Made-up sample company of the demo, deleted on {{at}}.
tenant.holidaysLead: As they apply with the saved settings.
